shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50

cat src/*.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 -i 'charts' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tail -15; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies --json | tail -12
npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart ChartData LineSeries
grep charts package.json; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart ChartData LineSeries 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; rg -n -i -C 3 'theme|setup|peer|styles' README.md | head -60; ls dist/docs
sed -n 1,200p dist/docs/get-started.md | head -120; rg -n -l 'useTheme|--g-color' dist/esm 2>/dev/null | head; ls dist

rg -n 'DEFAULT_PALETTE|getDefaultColors|palette' dist/esm --type js | head -15; rg -n "colors\?|title\?|datetime" dist/esm/types/chart/base.d.ts dist/esm/types/chart/axis.d.ts dist/esm/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls dist/esm/types/chart | head -40

ls dist/esm/plugins/line; rg -n "stroke|color" dist/esm/plugins/line/*.js | head -20; rg -n "export (type|interface) (ChartData|LineSeries)\b" -A 30 dist/esm/types dist/esm/core -g '*.d.ts' | head -80

rg -n "useTheme" dist/esm -g '*.js' | head; rg -n "export function validateSeriesColor" -A 15 dist/esm -g '*.js' | head -20; rg -n "title\?|type\?: |dateTimeLabelFormat|labels\?" dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "title\?" dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts

rg -n "ChartAxisType =|categories\?|export interface ChartAxisTitle|export interface ChartTitle" -A 4 dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts dist/esm/core/types/chart/title.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; rg -n "xAxis\?|yAxis\?|tooltip\?" dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts; rg -n "export interface LineSeriesData" -A 12 dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "enabled\?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/legend.d.ts | head -3; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
